periods.name: This Afternoon
periods.text: A chance of showers and thunderstorms before 5pm, then scattered showers and thunderstorms. Some of the storms could be severe. Mostly sunny, high near 91. West wind around 8 mph. Chance of precipitation 60%. New rainfall a tenth to a quarter inch possible.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.short: Storms, then patchy fog, low around 67
periods.text: Scattered showers and thunderstorms before 11pm, then patchy fog. Some of the storms could be severe. Mostly cloudy, low around 67. North wind 2 to 6 mph. Chance of precipitation 50%.

periods.name: Friday
